title: Emotion

question.instructions: Which emotion does the writer of this message express?

criteria.sadness: Feeling sad, down, hurt or hopeless.
criteria.joy: Feeling happy, pleased, content or excited.
criteria.love: Feeling affection, caring, tenderness or longing for someone.
criteria.anger: Feeling angry, irritated, resentful or frustrated.
criteria.fear: Feeling afraid, anxious, nervous or worried.
criteria.surprise: Feeling surprised, amazed, curious or caught off guard.

label_field: choice: the option key (sadness, joy, love, anger, fear, surprise)

title: Review star rating

question.instructions: How many stars did the reviewer give in this review?
criteria: 1 star: very negative, a bad experience.
2 stars: mostly negative, with few redeeming points.
4 stars: mostly positive, with minor complaints.
5 stars: very positive, an excellent experience.

label_field: score: integer level index starting at 0 (0 = 1 star ... 4 = 5 stars)
license: other - Yelp Dataset Agreement (dataset card: license_details 'yelp-licence')
